subject: Portal onboarding: role surge plan & segmented evidence handoff
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightcrest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@brightcrest.com
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: role surge plan & segmented evidence handoff

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the kickoff earlier. We're ready to start the portal onboarding this week but have a short window where our InfoSec team will only be available during US hours (Mon–Thu). Two small asks before we start: 

1) Can Redwood provide an owner map (CSV) that ties each questionnaire section to a named owner on your side? We want to route technical CAIQ items to our infra folks and product/security items to our compliance lead.
2) For evidence that lives in S3 (logs, sysdig exports), we need a sample presign workflow or a short-lived upload plan — the security team won't accept permanent links.

I've attached a consolidated questionnaire from our side (we're starting with SIG+CAIQ). If you can send a short owner heatmap and an example presign, we'll schedule the first evidence handoff on Thursday.

Best,
Marta
Security Program Manager
BrightCrest Financial

Attachments: sig-questionnaire.pdf (stub), api-access-matrix.csv (stub)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightcrest.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: role surge plan & segmented evidence handoff

Marta —

Appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers up-front:

- Owner heatmap: yes — attaching a first-pass CSV that maps SIG/CAIQ sections to owners on our side. Internal owners are initial points and we can change as we work through evidence.
- Presign sample: attaching a short script/example and a brief policy note outlining TTL (15m default) and ACL expectations.

Operational note: We anticipate a short role-surge for portal uploads. Kimberly will run the Whistic/Vendr upload window and Jonas will own the CAIQ/SIG question mapping. Suggested next steps:

  * Thu 10/22 11:00–11:30 PT — 30min evidence handoff (screen-share S3 presign + sample upload).
  * Deliverable by Fri EOD: completed SIG spreadsheet (answers + links) and a zipped evidence bundle for your ingestion team.

I've attached: SIG-answers-draft.xlsx (workbook), owner-heatmap.csv (work-in-progress), s3-presign-example.txt.

Thanks —
Rishi
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-answers-draft.xlsx (stub), owner-heatmap.csv (stub), s3-presign-example.txt (stub)

On Thu, Oct 22, 2026 at 09:03 AM Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> App...

Quick follow-up from the prep call — two clarifications for the BrightCrest team:

1) For SIG items 4.1–4.4 (network controls), our infra owner (Kimberly) will provide a short exported syslog sample. That export will be uploaded via presign to a staging bucket under the nomenclature brightcrest/rcv/<date>/syslog-sample.tar.gz.

2) For CAIQ sections where we reference policy docs (encryption-at-rest, key rotation), we can provide signed hashes of the documents and a signed manifest instead of full PDFs if BrightCrest prefers a minimal proof approach.

Action items assigned:
- Kimberly: run upload window & confirm IAM role for presign (owner-heatmap row 7).
- Rishi: finalize SIG spreadsheet answers and flag anything requiring legal redline.
- Marta: confirm Thu 11am PT or propose alternate.

Jonas
VP, Security Integrations (internal)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@brightcrest.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 15:02:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Portal onboarding: role surge plan & segmented evidence handoff

Thanks all — confirmed the Thu window and posting the presign runner in our shared drive.

Logistics summary for BrightCrest:
- Upload window: Thu 2026-10-22 11:00–11:30 PT (we can open a +30m buffer if needed).
- Presign TTL: 15 minutes by default; we can extend to 60 minutes for large bundles upon request (logged and auditable).
- File naming guidance: use brightcrest/rcv/<request-id>/<artifact-type>. For example brightcrest/rcv/BR-3412/syslog-sample-20261022.tar.gz.

Attached/upcoming: owner-heatmap.csv (final), SIG-answers-draft.xlsx (updated with Jonas notes).

If you want minimal proofs only (hash + manifest) call that out in the upload metadata and we'll mark the artifact as 'manifest-only' in the portal.

Kimberly Park
Security Operations Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachments: owner-heatmap.csv (final), SIG-answers-draft.xlsx (revA)
